title: Say Bulong ed Dagem
intro: Isipen pa so sakey a pasen ya say agnanengneng tan say nanengneng et mankakasakey, tan akaalagey ka ed arap na sakey a pigura ed puso na sakey a panarian ya ag mipara ed arum. Sayan kamarerwa et walaan na pikakabat ya ag naabot na ordinaryo, ya mangigaganggan na saray puersa ya naisip labat na arum. Balet, anggan say sankabiskegan et nayarin napaabeba na sakey a melmelag a pinalsa, tan say katuaan so nayarin mansiansian akaamot anggad aturon panaon. Siopa iyan pigura ya say legasiya to et onaalingaw ed inlabas na saray panaon?
clues: Niiter ed siak so sakey a panarian ya anggapo ed siopaman ya onsublay ed siak.
Atawir ko so pikakabat tan kakabatan manlapud inad-arok ya ateng.
Say dagem et walad silong na pakayarik, ya onkukurang unong ed ganggan ko inerman so labay ko.
Natatalosan ko so panagsalita na saray manok, tan nanlingkor ira ed armada ko.
Akaawat ak na balita manlapud melag a manok nipaakar ed sakey a reyna ya mandadayew ed banwa.
Say impatey ko et nansiansian akaamot anggad inakan na sakey a pinalsa ed dalin so baston ko, tan diad saman labat amoria na saray jinn ya agda amta so ag-anengneng.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
